title: Welcome & how mastery works
standardSummary: Explain how a lesson standard works and answer one short question about the course.
teach:
## Welcome

This is your Year 1 high-school Latin course. Classical pronunciation. Grammar first, with Roman context along the way.

### How each lesson works

1. **Standard** — what you must show you can do before the next lesson unlocks.
2. **Teach** — short explanation (this section).
3. **Practice** — forms grids, translations, and other activities.
4. **Check** — some items auto-check; free answers are graded by AI with feedback.
5. **Help** — use the tutor chat anytime with questions.
6. **More practice** — if you are not at standard yet, the app can give you more drills of the same types until you meet it.

There are **no letter grades**. You either meet the standard or keep practicing with guidance.

### Two workhorses

- **Ending grids** — add the right endings (you will do this a lot).
- **Translate this** — Latin ↔ English, from words up to sentences.
